description: This Java source file implements the WriteSurveyService interface, providing methods to register and fulfill surveys by interacting with data tables and permissions within the Fineract infrastructure.

classes.name: WriteSurveyServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the WriteSurveyService interface, providing methods to register and fulfill surveys, managing permissions and data table interactions.

methods.name: registerSurvey
methods.description: Registers a new survey by generating permission SQL and invoking the write service to register the data table.

methods.name: getPermissionSql
methods.description: Constructs an SQL string to insert permission entries for a given data table, including create, read, update, and delete permissions with associated checkers.

methods.name: fullFillSurvey
methods.description: Fulfills a survey by creating a PPI entry in the data table via the write service.
